data.title: Three mornings from the new flat
data.situation: The week after the tap repair, Lin compared three ways to get to work. On Monday she set out on foot. Roadworks blocked the direct route on her map, so she asked a shopkeeper for directions and walked around the park. It took eighteen minutes. On Tuesday she checked the bus timetable, but the bus came late. Rush hour traffic delayed it again, and the ride took thirty minutes, plus a fare. On Wednesday she cycled along a quieter street and arrived in fourteen minutes, although one crossing felt unsafe after dark. Lin wrote the actual times in her notebook. Walking was free and more reliable than the bus; cycling was quickest on bright mornings. She decided to leave twenty-five minutes before work, using the bus only when the weather made the other choices difficult.
data.goal: Ask for a way around a blocked path, compare real travel time and cost, and choose a reliable daily journey.
data.zhSupport: 搬家后，林分别试了步行、公交和骑车。施工让原先地图上的直路走不通；高峰期的公交晚点且花钱；骑车最快，但天黑后有一处路口让她不放心。她记录实际耗时，选择平日更可靠的走法。先用英文问路、比较，再作决定。

glossary.note: 用来说明出行方式，可与 by bus、by bike 对比。
route 是从一地到另一地走的路；direct 强调不绕路。
ask someone for directions：向某人询问怎么走；shopkeeper 是这个故事中提供帮助的人。
时刻表给出计划时间，不保证车辆实际准点。
在这里解释车辆为什么容易被拥堵影响。
reliable 在此比较每天耗时是否稳定，不等于一定最快。
这里指坐公交需要付的费用；步行不需这笔费用。
cycle 的过去式；故事中周三骑车去上班。
这里是动词 delay 的过去式，高峰交通让公交更慢。

glossary.zh: 从一处到另一处的路径
glossary.note: 采用来源名词路线义；direct route指直接走法，不保证永远畅通。
原R00616是course of movement方向义。复数directions作路线指示是外部延伸，不能归作来源原定义。

glossary.text: Could you give me directions to …?
glossary.zh: 请求到某处的走法说明
glossary.note: 复数directions在这里指路线指示，与原记录方向名词相关但不相同；to后接目的地。
matchTexts: Could you give me directions to the office by another route?

glossary.zh: 列出计划事件时间的表
glossary.note: 本来源为一般时间表；本课公交应用是项目桥接，计划表不等同实际到达。
本课及物动词；traffic delayed the bus，或the bus was delayed。不是延长所有路程的固有性质。
明确登记R00005动词义；不把R00757循环名词义并入。

glossary.zh: 结果可以依靠、便于计划的
glossary.note: 本课形容旅程用时较稳定。几次观察支持人物选择，不是长期统计或永久保证。

glossary.zh: 选择一种做法并说明原因
glossary.note: 根据给定条件选择一种做法，并说明与实际需求相关的理由；这里比较通勤可靠性。
matchTexts: I would choose the walking route because the arrival time is more reliable.

retrievalPrompts.function: Ask for a way around a blocked path
retrievalPrompts.cue: The street shown on your map is closed for building work. Ask a person in a nearby shop how to reach the office another way.
acceptableAnswers: Could you give me directions to the office by another route?
Is there another route to the office? The street on my map is closed.
retrievalPrompts.feedback: Say where you need to go and explain why the usual path cannot be used.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 地图上的街道因施工封闭。问附近店员怎样换一条路到办公室。
retrievalPrompts.feedbackZh: 目的地和阻断原因都说清楚。

retrievalPrompts.function: Explain why the planned arrival time was wrong
retrievalPrompts.cue: The printed schedule suggests the vehicle will arrive early, but heavy morning traffic makes it late. Explain the difference between the plan and the real journey.
acceptableAnswers: The bus timetable showed an early arrival, but rush hour traffic delayed the bus.
It was due earlier, but the bus was delayed in rush hour, so the journey took longer.
retrievalPrompts.feedback: Separate the planned time from the observed delay and name the cause if you know it.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 时刻表显示车辆会较早到达，但早上车多，实际晚了。说明计划与实际不同的原因。
checks: 计划时间与实际时间分开。
retrievalPrompts.feedbackZh: 可以用主动或被动表达延误，不把时刻表当成已经发生的结果。

retrievalPrompts.function: Compare travel modes, time and cost
retrievalPrompts.cue: You can walk, use a bicycle, or pay for a vehicle ride. Compare two choices using what Lin actually observed.
acceptableAnswers: On foot it took eighteen minutes and cost nothing; when she cycled, it took fourteen minutes.
Cycling was quickest, while the bus took thirty minutes and also cost a fare.
retrievalPrompts.feedback: Use actual times and cost rather than treating the shortest distance as the whole answer.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 步行、骑车、付车费坐公交三种选择中，比较两种，使用林实际测得的用时。
checks: 步行18分钟，骑车14分钟，公交30分钟。
retrievalPrompts.feedbackZh: 最短距离不能替代实际时间、费用与适用条件。

retrievalPrompts.cue: A short walk usually takes about the same time, while the vehicle often arrives late. Say what you will normally choose and why.
acceptableAnswers: I will usually take the walking route because it is more reliable than the bus.
I would walk on most days; it is a reliable journey even if cycling can be faster.
retrievalPrompts.feedback: A reliable option is one you can plan around. Your choice can change with darkness or bad weather.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 步行用时通常差不多，车辆常晚到。说明你平常会选哪种方式，为什么。
checks: 允许天气或天黑改变选择。
retrievalPrompts.feedbackZh: 可靠是可以据以计划，不等于任何条件下永远最快。

transferPrompt.function: Transfer journey comparison to a new class schedule
transferPrompt.cue: A student must reach an evening class. A train with one change is fast when it runs on time, but its arrival varies. Walking takes twenty-five minutes every time. Without reopening Lin's story, explain what you would check and which journey you would choose for an important class.
acceptableAnswers: I would check the train timetable and any delay, but I would go on foot if that route gives me a more reliable arrival time.
For an important class, I would choose the walking route because it reliably takes twenty-five minutes; I would check the train timetable only as a backup.
transferPrompt.feedback: The destination and time of day changed. Compare planned and actual reliability, then choose a route that fits the new commitment.
transferPrompt.cueZh: 学生要去晚课。换乘一次的火车准点时很快，但到达时间波动；步行每次25分钟。说明你要核实什么，以及重要课程那天会选什么。
checks: 区分计划时间与实际稳定性。
transferPrompt.feedbackZh: 根据新承诺选路线，而不是机械套用林的早班选择。

data.easySummary: Lin tries walking, taking a bus and cycling on different mornings. A closed road changes her walk, and traffic delays the bus. She records the actual times and chooses walking on most days, keeping weather and darkness in mind.
data.easySummaryZh: 林在不同早晨试了步行、公交和骑车。封路改变了步行路线，交通延误了公交。她记录实际用时，多数日子选择步行，同时考虑天气和天黑。
